name: ActiveCampaign
summary: Marketing automation and lifecycle email with a light CRM attached.
best_for: businesses that want deep marketing automation and lifecycle email tied to a light CRM, and will actually use the automation depth
skip_if: you just need to send a newsletter — a simpler, cheaper email tool does that without paying for automation you won't touch
honest_knock: Pricing climbs with contact count and the add-ons (CRM, SMS, extra seats) stack up fast — the sticker Starter price is not what a serious automation setup actually costs. Powerful, but budget for the tier (Plus and up) you'll really use.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and again 2026-09-29 in the browser; the figures below are the 'starts at' prices on annual billing, before you pick a contact count) No free plan, trial only. There are four tiers. Starter is from $15/mo with 1 user, limited segmentation and 5 actions per automation. Plus is from $49/mo with 1 user, standard segmentation, unlimited automation actions and landing pages. Pro is from $79/mo with 3 users, advanced segmentation, predictive and conditional content and attribution tracking. Enterprise is from $145/mo with 5 users, premium segmentation, SSO, custom objects and a dedicated account team. Your email send allowance is a multiple of your contact count — 10x on Starter and Plus, 12x on Pro, 15x on Enterprise. The bill then scales with list size, and the ladder only renders after you select a contact count: at 10,000 contacts on 2026-09-29 it read Starter $149, Plus $189, Pro $375 and Enterprise $589 a month on annual billing. A separate Email + WhatsApp plan starts at $112 (Plus), $142 (Pro) and $284 (Enterprise) a month, each with up to 5 WhatsApp lines. CRM pipelines, SMS and extra users remain paid add-ons.
